subject: Human Evolution
title: Peking Man
description: A fast breakdown of Peking Man for builders.

hook.text: In the 1920s, caves near Beijing yielded skulls of an ancient human: Peking Man, another Homo erectus.

buildup.text: Canadian anatomist Davidson Black championed the find, pulling funding from the Rockefeller Foundation.

discovery.text: The site showed evidence of fire use and tool-making dating back 750,000 years.

twist.text: During WWII, the original fossils were packed for shipment to the US and vanished forever.

climax.text: Casts and descriptions survive, but the originals remain one of science's greatest lost treasures.

punchline.text: War stole what caves preserved for millennia.

quiz.question: What happened to the original Peking Man fossils?
